scientific_integrity: The stated theorem is supported by a self-contained all-n proof and finite checker. Corroborating enumeration is not an infinite proof. Independent validation and exhaustive bibliography verification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary forts on fans only, counted by distinct labeled vertices. Existing complete fan zero-forcing-set membership predicates carry implicit blocker-dual information and are an acknowledged bibliographic-priority risk; stronger settings and arbitrary cone graphs not treated.
title: Minimal forts of fan graphs: structural classification and rational enumeration
